what: Live-run limits for the pilot rerun (MANAGER relay 2026-11-02 of Modules' Deploy VII comparison, commit 41d4ea7b): PF-R11..PF-R13

opus-medium.source: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/models/overview (Claude Opus 5.5 'Max output 128K tokens', synchronous Messages API), fetched 2026-11-02

deepseek-max.source: https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models/deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017/endpoints: lowest max_completion_tokens over the 43 endpoints (Particle AI, PrimeIntellect, Venice), fetched 2026-11-02

bytes_per_token_basis.openai: Measured with this repo's _request_bytes: pilot sol calls 4.314 and 4.317 bytes per token (2 calls, about 22 KB). Deploy VII live gpt-6.1-sol: min 4.885 over 36 calls up to 396,912 request bytes (artifacts/model-tests/**/metrics.json, read-only). 3.0 is Deploy VII's configured ratio and keeps a margin of at least 1.44x below every measurement.
bytes_per_token_basis.anthropic: Pilot opus measured 2.394-2.545, below 3.0, so no ratio above 1 is ruled here; 1 is sound by definition (a token is at least a byte) and over-reserves.
bytes_per_token_basis.openrouter: Pilot deepseek measured 3.329-3.572, Deploy VII deepseek min 3.791; kept at 1 (only Sol's 272K ContextTooLong was reported as blocking); owner item to revisit after the pilot.

overall_s_basis: Deploy VII sol-high took 692 s for 55K output tokens; 98,304 output tokens at that rate is about 1240 s, under 1800.

context_check.rule: ContextTooLong fires only where a price sets max_input_tokens (pricing.reservation_usd); only gpt-6.1-sol does (272000, standard tier). At 1 byte per token, opus and deepseek bounds stay inside the providers' windows.
context_check.cost_of_1: over-reservation only, e.g. about 5.6 USD input plus 1.97 USD output for a 700 KB Opus call, held for the call
